text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yup, super cute! Alright then, next up, 
together with Curren—

text_block_list.name: Timid-looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, no way, I can't! N-No matter how 
nicely you did my makeup, I-I just...!

text_block_list.name: Timid-looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I'm sooorrrryyyy~~~!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Curren? What's up? That girl just now 
seemed...
choice_data_list: She dashed off at incredible speed, but...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe. Actually, a little bit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan smiled with a hint of sorrow. 
I decided to ask her for more details.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I'm so happy that you came to Curren 
for help☆ What did you want to talk about?

text_block_list.name: Timid-looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
“...I want to become cute. I've never had 
any confidence in myself... I'm always 
looking down, and I'm so gloomy...”

text_block_list.name: Timid-looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...I really look up to Curren-san. She's 
so cute and radiant... That's why I want 
to—!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Wanting to be cute, wanting to 
gain confidence, huh?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
She gathered her courage to come ask 
Curren for advice... so I really wanted to 
help her out.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: And so...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Keep the lace light and the skirt 
knee-length. Let's find the sparkle that's 
uniquely yours♪

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Your skin is so lovely, too. Natural 
makeup might suit you best. For example—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm. Corners of the mouth up, big grin! 
Let's strike a pose with your absolute 
cutest smile☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
We all worked together, and when she 
looked in the mirror, she was so 
surprised... Curren thought it was super 
cute too.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
That's why I told you we should take 
photos and videos and post them on 
Umasta...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I want to have confidence in being 
'cute'... If so, I thought the words of 
those around me might lend me strength.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Ah... gotcha.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
True, sometimes it takes being praised by 
others to finally gain confidence in 
yourself...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However... asking a girl with truly no 
self-confidence to suddenly show her face 
on the internet is—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
As long as you can't accept yourself, it's 
definitely gonna be tough, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I nod in agreement. Even if she tries 
praising herself in the mirror, it's 
probably hard to carry those feelings 
outside of it.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"...'Outside the mirror', huh. You mean 
like, the moment you look away from the 
mirror, your usual self pops right back 
into your head?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Transcend shrugs her shoulders, quoting a 
line like something straight out of a 
movie."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...Curren, I guess I really didn't 
understand you after all..."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
That ain't true. We're just halfway 
through, ya know. From here on out—
choice_data_list: Let's take photos and videos just of her.
So that I can decorate her heart too.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
A private one...? Meaning you won't post 
it on social media?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yep. Simply put, it's about burning your 
own image into your eyes. So that you can 
still remember your current self even away 
from the mirror.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...Does that mean making things 
'aesthetic' and 'cute' for yourself first 
before anyone else...?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: By myself, on my own...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...! I... I think I might have figured it 
out!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you both very much! Curren will go 
tell her right away!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I watch Curren Chan run off.
choice_data_list: I hope it goes well, huh.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Of course I'll go. Curren worked so hard, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—A few days later, I saw a photo of that 
Umamusume smiling on social media. She 
still looked a bit stiff, but she seemed 
truly happy.”

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Your heart, too...?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yeah yeah. But Curren, you're not just 
cute on the outside, right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
choice_data_list: Just like you taught me to smile

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Decorating one's heart...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
It'll probably take some time, though. 
Still, as long as Curren's here to help, 
it shouldn't be a problem, right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Curren's cuteness makes everyone's 
hearts sparkle, after all!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Please wait for me, okay? Someday, I'll 
send you the most super-cute photo taken 
with her☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Waving with a beaming smile, Curren Chan 
walked away.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
When that time comes, we can't afford to 
lose either.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Pfft... Gotta start thinking of poses now, 
then.
